Definition: of uncertain affinity; a broad shallow cup ("phial"):--vial.
BiblicalUsage: Phiale is a broad shallow bowl, a vial, and in Revelation it holds both worship and wrath. The four beasts and the elders fall down with harps and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints, and the seven angels receive seven golden vials full of the wrath of God to pour upon the earth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the same bowl holds two things: the prayers of the saints and the wrath of God, and heaven pours out whichever one the earth has earned.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
